<thought>We need to find a template that breaks a ketone and a C‑C triple bond (both are valid functional group names in the catalog) and forms a new C‑C bond. We'll search the template catalog with those exact functional group names.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
